response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced software engineer with strong full-stack, systems, and testing credentials, but the role centers on deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation with IEC 62443 secure-development practices. His C++ exposure is limited to a six-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project, C++ is absent from his skills list, and there is no evidence of MQTT, message brokers in industrial contexts, IEC 62443/SDL, or industrial protocol experience. His high-performance DLang work shows relevant systems aptitude, but the gap to the core requirements is too large for a senior, hands-on C++ role.
strengths: Strong low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers, microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid engineering-craft background: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Broad technical versatility including event-driven architecture, Node.js, React, and cloud/Kubernetes exposure
concerns: Minimal and dated professional C++ experience (~6 months, ending in 2015); C++ not listed in current skills
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 experience; no MQTT or industrial protocol exposure (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Career trajectory is web/full-stack and AI tooling, misaligned with an on-prem industrial automation C++ role; cloud experience is AWS rather than Azure

key_factors.factor: Strong high-performance systems and engineering practices
